neurotic dermatosis.translation: [医] 神经机能病性皮肤病

neurotically.translation: adv. 神经质地；神经过敏地

neuroticism.definition: n a mental or personality disturbance not attributable to any known neurological or organic dysfunction

neurotics.definition: n. a person suffering from neurosis
neurotics.translation: n. 神经官能症的( neurotic的复数形式 ); 神经质的; 神经过敏的; 极为焦虑的

neurotigenic.translation: [医] 致神经机能病的, 致神经[官能]症的

neurotology.translation: [医] 神经耳科学, 耳神经学

neurotome.definition:
n. An instrument for cutting or dissecting nerves.
n. A neuromere.
neurotome.translation: [医] 神经刀; 神经管节

neurotomical.definition: a. Of or pertaining to neurotomy.

neurotomist.definition: n. One who skilled in or practices neurotomy.
neurotomist.translation: n. 神经解剖学家；神经切断术学家 (neurotomy的变形)

neurotomy.definition:
n. The dissection, or anatomy, of the nervous system.
n. The division of a nerve, for the relief of neuralgia, or
   for other purposes.
neurotomy.translation:
n. 神经切除, 神经解剖学, 神经切除术
[医] 神经切断术; 神经解剖学

neurotonia.translation: [医] 神经张力不稳定; 神经牵伸术

neurotonic.translation: [医] 神经牵伸术的; [使]神经强壮的; 神经强壮剂

neurotoxia.translation: [医] 神经中毒症(把神经衰弱看作一种中毒)

neurotoxic.definition: a. poisonous to nerves or nerve cells
neurotoxic.translation:
a. 毒害神经的
[医] 神经中毒的

neurotoxicity.translation: n. [农药] 神经中毒性, 神经毒性

neurotoxin.definition: n. any toxin that affects neural tissues
neurotoxin.translation:
[化] 神经毒素
[医] 神经毒素

neurotoxins.definition:
plural of neurotoxin
n. any toxin that affects neural tissues
neurotoxins.translation:
(neurotoxin 的复数) [化] 神经毒素
[医] 神经毒素

neurotransmitter.definition: n. a neurochemical that transmits nerve impulses across a synapse
neurotransmitter.translation:
n. 神经递质
[化] 神经递质

neurotransmitters.definition:
plural of neurotransmitter
n. a neurochemical that transmits nerve impulses across a synapse
neurotransmitters.translation:
(neurotransmitter 的复数) n. 神经递质
[化] 神经递质

neurotrast.translation: [医] 碘苯十一[烷]酸乙酯, 碘苯酯(脊髓造影剂)

neurotrophic.translation: a. 神经营养的,[解]向神经的,亲神经的

neurotrophic arthritis.translation: [医] 神经营养性关节炎, 神经病性关节炎

neurotropic.definition: a. (of a virus, toxin, or chemical) tending to attack or affect the nervous system preferentially
neurotropic.translation:
a. 亲神经的, 嗜神经组织的, 趋神经系的
[医] 向神经的, 亲神经的

neurotropism.definition: n an affinity for neural tissues
neurotropism.translation: n. [生]神经亲和力, 趋向神经性

neurotropy.translation: [医] 向神经性, 亲神经性

neurovisceral.translation: [医] 脑脊髓[与]交感神经系统的

neurula.definition:
n. An embryo or certain invertebrates in the stage when the
   primitive band is first developed.
neurula.translation: n. [动]神经轴胚, 神经芽

neururgic.translation: [医] 神经活动的, 神经作用的
